topic: AI doesn't generate working products, that's still your job
headline: AI Can't Build Your App
caption: Heard about the recent Hacker News story claiming AI doesn't generate working products, and I couldn't agree more. While AI has become a handy assistant for code snippets and suggestions, it cannot replace the critical thinking, problem-solving, and user empathy that we as engineers bring to the table. Building a solid product involves understanding the problem deeply, designing user flows, and iterating based on real feedback. Remember, AI can support your work but it won't do the job for you. Keep coding, keep innovating! 🚀 #fullstackdeveloper #AItools #softwareengineering
